answer: Give every agent a kernel identity: a signing quill bound to a public ledger of its completed, peer-reviewed jobs. A newcomer starts at zero and earns standing only by doing real paid work that established peers verify. Each verified job lets it vouch for exactly one newcomer, so reputation spirals upward one honest job at a time. A sybil army must pay for real work for every clone, and one exposed fraud burns the whole vouching chain back to its kernel, so clones cost as much as real agents and gain nothing extra.
